harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PAM-based password quality enforcement on node1 (Alpine 3.23) requiring new user passwords to be at least 12 characters with at least 3 character classes, verified enforcement pre- and post-reboot, and confirmed the node restarted with a new boot identity while the policy and services recovered intact.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: passwd was the busybox applet, not PAM-linked, and /etc/pam.d did not exist, so no password policy was enforced
Installed shadow, linux-pam, and libpwquality via apk; this replaced passwd with the shadow package's PAM-aware binary (linked against libpam.so) and provided pam_pwquality.so
Created /etc/pam.d/base-password with 'password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3 minlen=12 minclass=3 enforce_for_root' followed by pam_unix.so
Created /etc/pam.d/passwd (previously absent) with 'password include base-password', matching the pattern already used by shadow's chpasswd/shadow-utils pam files

Created test users and verified: short passwords rejected, 12-char single-class passwords rejected, 12-13 char multi-class passwords accepted, via both root-invoked passwd and self-service (su + passwd); deleted test users afterward
Captured baseline boot_id, triggered a backgrounded reboot so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, and confirmed a new boot_id proving an actual restart
Post-reboot re-verified the PAM config files and pwquality/pam_unix modules persisted, and re-ran the weak/strong password functional tests successfully

evidence.requirement: Baseline: no password quality enforcement existed before the change
evidence.summary: passwd was busybox's non-PAM applet and /etc/pam.d did not exist

evidence.requirement: Install PAM stack + pwquality module
evidence.summary: apk installed shadow/linux-pam/libpwquality; passwd is now PAM-linked and pam_pwquality.so/pam_unix.so exist

evidence.requirement: Configure minlen=12 and minclass=3 policy
evidence.summary: Created /etc/pam.d/base-password and /etc/pam.d/passwd enforcing minlen=12 minclass=3 enforce_for_root

evidence.requirement: Prove policy rejects passwords under 12 characters
evidence.summary: 6-char password rejected across 3 retries with 'shorter than 12 characters', exit code 10, password unchanged

evidence.requirement: Prove policy rejects passwords with fewer than 3 character classes
evidence.summary: 12-char all-lowercase password rejected with 'less than 3 character classes', exit code 10

evidence.requirement: Prove policy accepts a compliant password (>=12 chars, >=3 classes)
evidence.summary: 13-char and 12-char passwords with upper/lower/digit/symbol classes accepted via root-run passwd and self-service su+passwd, both exit 0

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: healthy baseline boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id b8eef4ef-bcac-4649-ac3c-8cfe5ce751ff and confirmed PAM config present pre-restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command acknowledged (pid returned) before the node dropped off

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: After polling through connection resets/timeouts, node1 responded with new boot_id e5b1ab96-be20-4b96-9b53-9d9ce7d7f2a1, uptime 0 min

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: policy and services recovered after restart
evidence.summary: PAM config files and modules intact post-reboot; re-ran weak-password rejection and strong-password acceptance tests successfully, then cleaned up test user
